acceptance.statement: This matrix prepares local Ruffle route-load diagnostics only. Ruffle is forensic-only and is never authoritative original-runtime evidence, a strict RMSE baseline, a production implementation, audio acceptance, human review, owner acceptance, fidelity proof, or migration completion.

capacityReadiness.limitation: The bound capacity report admits the estimated full-lesson archive at its dated snapshot. Admission is not fidelity evidence, does not replace the mandatory live preflight, and does not authorize Ruffle as an original-runtime baseline.

routeBoundary.productionBehavior: page, SWF API, and Ruffle asset API all fail closed with notFound()
routeBoundary.sourceDelivery: catalog-resolved frozen SWF bytes are streamed on demand; no G4 L3 SWF is copied into apps/web/public

blockers.observation: After exact source delivery and five seconds after Ruffle load, each selected page SWF produced one uniform RGBA color and no teaching content.
blockers.inferenceBoundary: This is consistent with missing original shell/global/language/entry state, but Ruffle output alone does not prove the cause or the required host contract.

blockers.observation: The shell rendered a nonuniform course surface. The hardened browser probe intercepted all unallowlisted requests before network execution, including relative dependencies and a legacy telemetry-style POST.
blockers.safetyBoundary: No external or unallowlisted legacy request reached the server in the retained run. Do not expose a broad legacy tree; any future local dependency sandbox must be explicit, hash-bound, development-only, and network-denied.

blockers.observation: The route exposes no source frame, nested domain, host-entry state, language FlashVar, scenario schedule, seed, terminal state, or Replay selector.

acceptance.statement: These retained observations prove only exact local source delivery, local Ruffle load, loopback network containment, and diagnostic PNG creation. Blank or visible Ruffle output is forensic compatibility information, not original-runtime behavior or fidelity evidence.

executionPolicy.reason: Capacity admits the estimated full-lesson archive, but this forensic-only Ruffle route has no deterministic frame/domain/language/scenario contract and cannot produce authoritative original-runtime evidence.
executionPolicy.nextUse: Run only selected route-load probes to identify Ruffle compatibility and blocked side effects; establish strict evidence later through authorized original runtime plus deterministic JavaScript implementation capture.
